name: Umami Weekly SEO Report
description: Summarize self-hosted Umami traffic, compare two rolling weeks of page visitors, and save both analyses in one Baserow row.
requirements: Self-hosted Umami 3.4.1 with a canonical HTTPS /api base reachable from the execution server; each read must finish within 30 seconds and 4 MiB
Umami self-hosted API key whose user can view the selected website, stored as a secret Variable; this template does not use Umami Cloud
Configure an available gateway model separately on both Open Flow AI Agent nodes; n8n requires an OpenRouter API key and an available model ID
Baserow Cloud database-token connection and table with Date, Summary, Top pages and Blog name fields; configure the actual table ID
Review the Thursday 00:00 UTC schedule and processing timezone; data from both responses must fit the chosen model contexts

source.path: AI_Research_RAG_and_Data_Analysis/Summarize Umami data with AI (via Openrouter) and save it to Baserow.json
